warrant: The histories follow relativistic phase-space transport and self-consistent electromagnetic Weibel growth. In rt_vlasov_sr_weibel_1x3v.c, alpha (line 102) enters the anisotropic distribution and the magnetic seed B_z (lines 190, 204, 272 to 275), and model_id GKYL_MODEL_SR (line 430) selects the vlasov/zero/sr_vlasov kernels that vlasov/apps couples to Maxwell. A wrong relativistic velocity map, flux, current sign, Maxwell update or moment reduction changes these histories at order one. Calibration on the x86 worker (2026-09-05): the two-ULP variant spread is 5.3e-14 and the strict-IEEE altbuild (same source, gcc -O2, no -ffast-math, -ffp-contract=off, no -march=native) differs by 5.7e-13, on a near-zero moment sample where the absolute term governs. The bound atol=rtol=1e-10, set at review on 2026-09-04, is about 175 times that floor and leaves room for a different arithmetic on the target on a check the survey flags as chaotic.
